target.title: fix(nostr): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text
target.body:
Part of #90684

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Nostr users receiving bot replies would see internal assistant tool-trace scaffolding lines (e.g. `⚠️ 🛠️ `search repos (agent)` failed`) leaked into outbound messages. These banners are internal runtime diagnostics that should not reach end users.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Nostr outbound adapter lacked a `sanitizeText` hook, so core `stripInternalRuntimeScaffolding` was the only sanitization layer — and it does not remove tool-trace failure banners. Adding `sanitizeAssistantVisibleText` on the outbound `sanitizeText` hook matches the accepted sibling pattern already shipped for Slack, Signal, Matrix, Feishu, Mattermost, Telegram, Google Chat, QQBot, IRC, SMS, Discord, WhatsApp, LINE, and Nextcloud Talk.

## User Impact

Nostr users no longer see internal tool-trace failure banners in bot replies. Normal assistant prose and markdown table conversion behavior are preserved.

## Evidence

**Negative control — core strip keeps banner (pre-fix behavior):**

```
$ node --import tsx -e '
import { stripInternalRuntimeScaffolding } from "./src/infra/outbound/sanitize-text.js";
const text = "Done.\n⚠️ 🛠️ `search repos (agent)` failed";
console.log("Output:", JSON.stringify(stripInternalRuntimeScaffolding(text)));
console.log("Banner survives:", stripInternalRuntimeScaffolding(text).includes("⚠️"));'

Output: "Done.\n⚠️ 🛠️ `search repos (agent)` failed"
Banner survives: true
```

**After fix — nostrPlugin.outbound.sanitizeText strips banner:**

```
$ node --import tsx -e '
import { nostrPlugin } from "./extensions/nostr/src/channel.js";
const text = "Done.\n⚠️ 🛠️ `search repos (agent)` failed";
const result = nostrPlugin.outbound?.sanitizeText?.({ text, payload: { text } });
console.log("Output:", JSON.stringify(result));
console.log("Banner stripped:", !result?.includes("⚠️"));
const prose = "The pipeline has 3 open deals.";
const proseResult = nostrPlugin.outbound?.sanitizeText?.({ text: prose, payload: { text: prose } });
console.log("Prose:", JSON.stringify(proseResult));
console.log("Prose unchanged:", proseResult === prose);'

Output: "Done."
Banner stripped: true
Prose: "The pipeline has 3 open deals."
Prose unchanged: true
```

**Focused test:**

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/nostr/src/outbound-tool-trace-sanitize.test.ts --run

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  2 passed (2)
```

**Lint (changed files):**

```
$ node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs extensions/nostr/src/gateway.ts extensions/nostr/src/outbound-tool-trace-sanitize.test.ts

(no findings)
```

Verified on branch `fix/nostr-sanitize-outbound-90684` at `98f7d7c79e6`.

**What was not tested:** No live Nostr relay round-trip — credentials were not available in this checkout. The bug is in the sanitization layer before network delivery, so the proof above covers the affected boundary without a live channel.

AI-assisted: Cursor (Claude). Proof run manually.

Sibling references: #101708 (LINE), #101712 (Nextcloud Talk), merged #98705 (Feishu).
